subject: BUG-254: awardHouseMastery can never fire for Matrix or Factionless, and accepts 3 ids that are not houses
description:
Found 2026-09-03 by Nancy during the BUG-253 vote, PRE-EXISTING and independent of it. ProgressManager.js:1103 hardcodes a LOCAL VALID_HOUSES list inside awardHouseMastery: ['web','shield','forge','script','cloud','code','key','eye','ai','linux','arena','dark-arts']. The canonical static HOUSES registry (:229-241) is a DIFFERENT set of 11: web, shield, forge, script, cloud, code, key, eye, dark-arts, matrix, divergent. Two consequences, both live. (1) matrix and divergent are MISSING from VALID_HOUSES, and the function returns early on any id not in it, so no student can ever be awarded House of the Matrix or The Factionless mastery -- HOUSE_MASTERY_XP is 10000 each, so that is 20000 XP permanently unreachable. (2) ai, linux and arena are in VALID_HOUSES but are not houses at all, so the guard whose stated purpose is 'reject garbage house IDs to prevent inflated course completions' accepts three garbage ids. TWO DEFINITIONS OF ONE QUESTION, the same mistake shape as the hex shell suggester regression: the authoritative list is HOUSES and a second hand-maintained copy drifted from it. Fix: derive from Object.keys(HOUSES) rather than restating it, so it cannot drift again. DEPENDENCY: BUG-253's chosen fix migrates operator progress into matrix; until this is fixed that moves data from a bucket that cannot earn mastery into another bucket that cannot earn mastery, so the mastery half of BUG-253 is not actually repaired by the migration alone.
[2026-09-04 04:41] EXTENDED by the BUG-253 review: it is THREE houses, not two. dark-arts, matrix and divergent have NO entry in LearningPaths.PATHS at all (only web, shield, forge, script, cloud, code, key, eye do). So mastery is blocked twice over for matrix and divergent (absent from VALID_HOUSES AND no path), and once for dark-arts (in VALID_HOUSES but pathModules.length>0 is false). The 8 houses in VALID_HOUSES' first 8 slots are EXACTLY the 8 with paths, so that list was derived from LearningPaths once and never updated. Fixing this is a real scope decision (either author 3 houses' worth of LearningPaths content, or rewrite the mastery gating), not a drive-by.
[2026-09-04 15:23] PARTIAL FIX in this commit: VALID_HOUSES now derived from HOUSES via hasOwnProperty, so ai/linux/arena are rejected and matrix/divergent accepted. STILL OPEN: dark-arts, matrix and divergent have no LearningPaths entry, so the caller's pathModules.length>0 check still blocks mastery for all three. That needs curriculum content, not a code fix.
[2026-09-06 03:05] REOPENED SCOPE: my derive-from-HOUSES fix silently dropped 'ai' from mastery eligibility (the old hand-written list had it). Latent not live, because 'ai' has no LearningPaths entry so the caller's pathModules.length>0 gate already blocked it. Root cause is BUG-261: HOUSES itself omits a house 87 live files use. Deriving from an authoritative source is only safe if that source is complete, and I did not audit it.
